description: Create size variations from a source artboard. Duplicates all objects and scales them, and the gaps between them, by the same factor, so the layout keeps its proportions instead of being stretched along one axis. The scaled artwork is centered on the target artboard, so changing the aspect ratio leaves empty space rather than distorting the composition — move or realign it afterwards if you want it elsewhere. New artboards are placed to the right of all existing artboards; copies get new UUIDs. Limitations: no text reflow, effects/strokes scale with objects but may need manual adjustment, no smart layout.

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

scale_mode.description: How to scale objects: proportional (fit within, maintain aspect), fit_width, or fit_height

source_artboard_index.description: Source artboard index to duplicate from (0-based)
